faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Nilgiris DRDPR Record Clerk recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Nilgiris DRDPR Record Clerk positions is 29th September 2026. Candidates are strongly advised to submit their applications well in advance of this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the Record Clerk post?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for the Record Clerk post is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 37 years. Age relaxation is provided for certain categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Record Clerk position?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 10th standard (Matriculation) from a recognized board to be eligible for the Record Clerk post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Record Clerk post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Record Clerk post will receive a salary in the pay scale of Rs. 15,900 to Rs. 58,500 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Nilgiris DRDPR Record Clerk job?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, attach required documents, and send it to the specified address before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies for the Record Clerk post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Record Clerk post announced under this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What are the selection criteria for the Record Clerk position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Record Clerk post involves Document Verification and an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in these stages.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the Record Clerk recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, an application fee of Rs. 50/- is applicable for SC/ST/Differently Abled/Widows/Ex-Servicemen categories. Other categories may have different fee structures or exemptions as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, where a direct link to the PDF will be provided. It is also available on the official website of Nilgiris District Rural Development and Panchayat Raj.

faq.answer: The official website of Nilgiris District Rural Development and Panchayat Raj is https://nilgiris.nic.in. Candidates can visit this site for more information and to download the application form.
